sections.title: Methodology: the proposed ReMedFiLM FULL system

figures.caption: V8 adjudication of the three VAL808 macro-Dice values. Left: the canonical FULL result (teal), its GlobalMedFiLM comparator (blue), and the legacy 0.837862 (rejected). Right: the genuine three-seed values re-aggregated from the frozen per-sample NPZ archive, with seed 42 matching the saved-mask re-score to approximately 6×10⁻⁷. The legacy value is the mean of three numbers hard-coded into the V5/V6/V7 generators, not a measurement.

Code-verified three-panel methodology. Panel A: four multi-domain inputs and three distinct task representations. Panel B: the full inference state machine of `RAMedFiLMBARR.forward_inference`, showing G → action/ROI → B_phi → utility test → offline OOF refined crop → deterministic fusion → S_omega → accept/reject, with both skip states. Panel C: the six-step sequential training dependency, explicitly not joint end-to-end training. Blue denotes GlobalMedFiLM, teal denotes the proposed ReMedFiLM FULL system.

The four canonical VAL808 states of `RAMedFiLMBARR.forward_inference`. FORCED_SKIP occurs when no action is available; SKIP_GLOBAL occurs when the router utility falls below tau_C8. Executed cases split into accept and reject according to S_omega. Counts are from the frozen Phase 27 prediction table.

Component-presence matrix. Only the FULL assembly instantiates all four components; GlobalMedFiLM alone instantiates G only. This is the identity check that prevents the backbone from being reported as the proposed model.

Portrait print variant of the **same** verified state machine shown in Figure 2, reformatted for single-column manuscript reproduction. It is not a second architecture and introduces no additional pathways or objectives.
Domain and split composition of the internal four-domain cohort.
KUB unit-of-analysis: full-field radiographs versus ROI instance patches.
Population accounting across TRAIN, VAL808, router development/holdout and the protected TEST1683 cohort.
Per-domain comparison of GlobalMedFiLM and ReMedFiLM FULL across Dice, IoU, precision and recall on VAL808.
Paired per-image Δ Dice by domain with the macro estimate and its domain-stratified bootstrap interval.
Bootstrap distribution of the paired macro Δ Dice (10,000 stratified resamples, seed 20261027). The percentile interval excludes zero.

Four independent objective histories — G, R_psi, B_phi and S_omega. Each panel uses a single genuine run ID for both train and validation curves. The B_phi Huber loss shows a large epoch-1 transient; panels are individually scaled. These are four separate training procedures, not one joint run.
GlobalMedFiLM validation macro Dice across the recorded training epochs.
Per-domain learning curves for the shared backbone, showing the unequal convergence of the four domains.

Real segmentation examples — ISIC 2018 dermoscopy. Each row shows the input, ground truth, the GlobalMedFiLM backbone output and the ReMedFiLM FULL output with the ROI and the routing/safety decision annotated. Differences are typically local boundary adjustments rather than whole-mask changes, consistent with the small paired Δ Dice.

Representative failure cases retained as negative evidence. These include harmful refinements and false-positive foreground on stone-free radiographs; they are shown because the aggregate Dice gain does not imply uniform per-image benefit.
KUB stone morphological subclasses. Performance varies across subclasses; the strata are descriptive and the subgroup sample sizes are small.
KUB stone size stratification. Small objects remain the dominant failure mode, consistent with the poor external Stones-Where-Are-You result in Section 8.

External metric coverage. Six metrics × two systems × three cohorts, with cells annotated by the true denominator. Partial-coverage cells (n = 6/20 for Stones HD95, ASSD and recall) are visually distinguished rather than presented as full-cohort estimates.
External Dice by cohort and system, with the stone-free subgroup shown separately.
Paired external Δ Dice distribution by cohort. The IQR sits exactly on zero for the stone-free subgroup, so most external images are unchanged.

Negative result: all 14 stone-free external images receive false-positive foreground predictions from both systems. S_omega scores refinement benefit (sign of Δ Dice), not lesion presence, and therefore cannot suppress a false positive that is already present in the backbone output.
Component progression: conditional compute and harm share across stages. Routing removes most of the harm introduced by unconditional refinement.

All 13 arms with mean true Δ Dice on routed cases. Blue = A7 (learned routing), teal = A8 (A7 + post-safety), amber = A1 (always refine), red = F1 (deliberate failure). The A8 − A7 paired contrast CI [-0.00, 0.00] includes zero: **the incremental safety contribution is not established**.
Paired contrasts between selected arms with intervals. Only contrasts whose interval excludes zero are described as established.

Three downstream seeds on the shared frozen backbone: macro-domain VAL808 Dice and paired Δ Dice versus the frozen G backbone. Descriptive only; no seed was retrained for V8 and the backbone is common to all three.
Perturbation robustness: degradation of segmentation quality under the recorded input perturbations. This is a descriptive stress test, not a certification of clinical robustness.

Accuracy versus architectural cost with the canonical ReMedFiLM FULL point at Dice 0.8373 and 32.4379 expected conditional GMACs. **Historical descriptive comparison**, not a confirmed Pareto frontier: the baseline protocols are not matched controlled experiments, and V7's point was wrong on both axes (0.837862 paired with the always-refine 34.72 GMACs).
Recorded latency breakdown by pipeline stage for the frozen runtime.
Accuracy against parameter count on a log axis, placing the compact FULL system in the context of the historical six-model comparison.

tables.caption: Canonical component chain of the proposed model (verified by read-only checkpoint state-dict loading).
Verified per-stage objectives. Each stage is supervised independently; no gradient passes between stages.
Source datasets. Dataset licences are separate from the repository code, which currently has no licence file.
Population accounting used in V8. Values are counts of images unless stated.
VAL808 internal results. ReMedFiLM FULL versus its GlobalMedFiLM backbone, seed 42, identical images and identical output threshold.
VAL808 context of the frozen six-model comparison. These are historical descriptive results, **not** a matched controlled experiment.
External retrospective results: Dice and HD95 for the GlobalMedFiLM backbone and the proposed ReMedFiLM FULL system. Direction is consistent across cohorts; margins are small.
Frozen component progression. Stage 0 is the backbone; Stage 4 is the canonical VAL808 state machine.
Selected ablation arms on ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT (n = 4,957). Full 13-arm provenance is in REMEDFILM_V8_ABLATION_RESULTS.csv.
VAL808 state-machine outcomes and their downstream masks.
Three-seed reconciliation. Genuine values re-aggregated from the frozen per-sample NPZ archive with the same equal-domain-weight rule.
Verified computational cost. Latency is the recorded p50 for the frozen runtime; GMACs are analytical for a 3 × 512 × 512 input.
Claims supported by frozen artifacts, and the evidence class that supports each.
V8 deliverables referenced by this report (paths relative to the repository root).
